identity: Golgari attrition midrange built on the same payoff as the Jund list but without red's repeatable conversion outlets. Uurg, Spawn of Turg is still the clock - its power is the count of land cards in your graveyard - but here the graveyard fills passively rather than on demand: Uurg's own upkeep surveil and its {B}{G} land sacrifice, Eerie Soultender's mill three, Urborg Lhurgoyf's kicked mill three, Shadow Prophecy binning the remainder of its own dig, Braids sacrificing a land every end step, and Liliana's +1. Nine of the 23 nonland cards can bin a land against the Jund build's twelve, and none of the nine is a repeatable on-demand outlet, which is why this deck's thesis turn is 8 rather than 7. What two colours buy in exchange is the cube's deepest removal suite and a mana base that actually works. The deck trades on the axis it is best at: it kills the opponent's threats one for one, exiles every opposing creature that dies with Nemata, drains with Sheoldred, and eventually attacks with a Uurg that has grown too large to block.

restrictions.extra_constraint: max 5 rare+mythic cards total across mainboard and sideboard

mainboard.name: Cut Down
mainboard.oracle_text: Destroy target creature with total power and toughness 5 or less.
mainboard.role: Interaction — 1-mana instant removal

mainboard.name: Tear Asunder
mainboard.oracle_text:
Kicker {1}{B} (You may pay an additional {1}{B} as you cast this spell.)
Exile target artifact or enchantment. If this spell was kicked, exile target nonland permanent instead.
mainboard.role: Interaction — modal exile (kicked: any nonland permanent)

mainboard.name: Extinguish the Light
mainboard.oracle_text: Destroy target creature or planeswalker. If its mana value was 3 or less, you gain 3 life.
mainboard.role: Interaction — unconditional creature/planeswalker removal

mainboard.name: Liliana of the Veil
mainboard.oracle_text:
+1: Each player discards a card.
−2: Target player sacrifices a creature.
−6: Separate all permanents target player controls into two piles. That player sacrifices all permanents in the pile of their choice.
mainboard.role: Interaction — symmetric discard (bins our lands) + edict

mainboard.name: Urborg Repossession
mainboard.oracle_text:
Kicker {1}{G} (You may pay an additional {1}{G} as you cast this spell.)
Return target creature card from your graveyard to your hand. You gain 2 life. If this spell was kicked, return another target permanent card from your graveyard to your hand.
mainboard.role: Payoff — kicked, returns a land AND a creature from the graveyard to hand

mainboard.name: Yavimaya Iconoclast
mainboard.oracle_text:
Kicker {R} (You may pay an additional {R} as you cast this spell.)
Trample
When this creature enters, if it was kicked, it gets +1/+1 and gains haste until end of turn.
mainboard.role: Threat — 3/2 trample two-drop; kicked {R} unavailable, cast on base cost

mainboard.name: Urborg Lhurgoyf
mainboard.oracle_text:
Kicker {U} and/or {B} (You may pay an additional {U} and/or {B} as you cast this spell.)
As this creature enters, mill three cards for each time it was kicked.
Urborg Lhurgoyf's power is equal to the number of creature cards in your graveyard and its toughness is equal to that number plus 1.
mainboard.role: Threat/Enabler — kicked {B}, mills three; power = creature cards in your graveyard

mainboard.name: Uurg, Spawn of Turg
mainboard.oracle_text:
Uurg's power is equal to the number of land cards in your graveyard.
At the beginning of your upkeep, surveil 1. (Look at the top card of your library. You may put that card into your graveyard.)
{B}{G}, Sacrifice a land: You gain 2 life.
mainboard.role: Payoff — power = land cards in your graveyard; upkeep surveil; sac-a-land outlet

mainboard.name: Eerie Soultender
mainboard.oracle_text:
When this creature enters, mill three cards. (Put the top three cards of your library into your graveyard.)
{4}{B}, Exile this card from your graveyard: Return another target creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
mainboard.role: Engine — ETB mill three (bins lands)

mainboard.name: Shadow Prophecy
mainboard.oracle_text: Domain — Look at the top X cards of your library, where X is the number of basic land types among lands you control. Put up to two of them into your hand and the rest into your graveyard. You lose 2 life.
mainboard.role: Engine — instant-speed dig; the remainder goes to the graveyard

mainboard.name: Braids, Arisen Nightmare
mainboard.oracle_text: At the beginning of your end step, you may sacrifice an artifact, creature, enchantment, land, or planeswalker. If you do, each opponent may sacrifice a permanent of their choice that shares a card type with it. For each opponent who doesn't, that player loses 2 life and you draw a card.
mainboard.role: Engine — end-step land sacrifice into draw/drain

mainboard.name: Braids's Frightful Return
mainboard.oracle_text:
Read ahead (Choose a chapter and start with that many lore counters. Add one after your draw step. Skipped chapters don't trigger. Sacrifice after III.)
I — You may sacrifice a creature. If you do, each opponent discards a card.
II — Return target creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
III — Target opponent may sacrifice a nonland, nontoken permanent of their choice. If they don't, they lose 2 life and you draw a card.
mainboard.role: Engine — saga: discard, creature recursion, then sac-or-draw

mainboard.name: Nemata, Primeval Warden
mainboard.oracle_text:
Reach
If a creature an opponent controls would die, exile it instead. When you do, create a 1/1 green Saproling creature token.
{G}, Sacrifice a Saproling: Nemata gets +2/+2 until end of turn.
{1}{B}, Sacrifice two Saprolings: Draw a card.
mainboard.role: Answer/Engine — exiles opposing creatures that would die (BG's only graveyard hate); Saproling draw outlet; 3/4 reach

mainboard.name: Sheoldred, the Apocalypse
mainboard.oracle_text:
Deathtouch
Whenever you draw a card, you gain 2 life.
Whenever an opponent draws a card, they lose 2 life.
mainboard.role: Threat — 4/5 deathtouch; drain on every draw

mainboard.name: Bortuk Bonerattle
mainboard.oracle_text: Domain — When Bortuk Bonerattle enters, if you cast it, choose target creature card in your graveyard. Return that card to the battlefield if its mana value is less than or equal to the number of basic land types among lands you control. Otherwise, put it into your hand.
mainboard.role: Top end — 4/4 that reanimates a creature at or below the Domain count

mainboard.name: Phyrexian Rager
mainboard.oracle_text: When this creature enters, you draw a card and you lose 1 life.
mainboard.role: Engine — 2/2 body that draws a card; one of only 4 real draw effects

mainboard.name: Swamp
mainboard.role: Land — B

mainboard.name: Forest
mainboard.role: Land — G

mainboard.name: Haunted Mire
mainboard.oracle_text:
({T}: Add {B} or {G}.)
This land enters tapped.
mainboard.role: Land — BG dual (Swamp Forest), enters tapped

mainboard.name: Contaminated Aquifer
mainboard.oracle_text:
({T}: Add {U} or {B}.)
This land enters tapped.
mainboard.role: Land — taps for B; Island Swamp adds the Island basic land type

mainboard.name: Radiant Grove
mainboard.oracle_text:
({T}: Add {G} or {W}.)
This land enters tapped.
mainboard.role: Land — taps for G; Forest Plains adds a fourth basic land type

mainboard.name: Geothermal Bog
mainboard.oracle_text:
({T}: Add {B} or {R}.)
This land enters tapped.
mainboard.role: Land — taps for B; Swamp Mountain adds the Mountain basic land type

sideboard.name: Broken Wings
sideboard.oracle_text: Destroy target artifact, enchantment, or creature with flying.
sideboard.when_to_board: vs artifact, enchantment or evasion decks; evasion is 51 cards / 21% of the cube

sideboard.name: Snarespinner
sideboard.oracle_text:
Reach
Whenever this creature blocks a creature with flying, this creature gets +2/+0 until end of turn.
sideboard.role: Blocker — reach, +2/+0 when blocking a flier

sideboard.name: Choking Miasma
sideboard.oracle_text:
Kicker {G} (You may pay an additional {G} as you cast this spell.)
If this spell was kicked, put a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
All creatures get -2/-2 until end of turn.
sideboard.when_to_board: vs go-wide token boards (Tokens is the cube's 2nd-largest cluster at 38 cards)

sideboard.name: Tear Asunder
sideboard.oracle_text:
Kicker {1}{B} (You may pay an additional {1}{B} as you cast this spell.)
Exile target artifact or enchantment. If this spell was kicked, exile target nonland permanent instead.
sideboard.role: Answer — exile any nonland permanent when kicked

sideboard.name: Pilfer
sideboard.oracle_text: Target opponent reveals their hand. You choose a nonland card from it. That player discards that card.
sideboard.role: Disruption — target opponent discards a nonland card of your choice
sideboard.when_to_board: vs control and single-card-reliant decks, where BG has no way to interact on the stack

sideboard.name: Bite Down
sideboard.oracle_text: Target creature you control deals damage equal to its power to target creature or planeswalker you don't control.
sideboard.role: Removal — target creature you control deals damage equal to its power to a creature or planeswalker you don't control
sideboard.when_to_board: vs decks whose threats exceed Cut Down's 'total power and toughness 5 or less' cap; a two-mana uncapped answer off Uurg or Sheoldred

identity_es: Midrange de desgaste Golgari construido sobre la misma recompensa que la lista Jund pero sin los medios de conversión repetibles del rojo. Uurg, Spawn of Turg sigue siendo el reloj — su fuerza es el recuento de cartas de tierra en tu cementerio — pero aquí el cementerio se llena de forma pasiva en lugar de a demanda: el surveil de mantenimiento del propio Uurg y su sacrificio de tierra por {B}{G}, el moler tres de Eerie Soultender, el moler tres kickeado de Urborg Lhurgoyf, Shadow Prophecy enterrando el resto de su propia cavada, Braids sacrificando una tierra en cada paso final, y el +1 de Liliana. Nueve de las 23 cartas no-tierra pueden enterrar una tierra frente a las doce de la construcción Jund, y ninguna de las nueve es un medio repetible a demanda, que es por lo que el turno de tesis de este mazo es el 8 y no el 7. Lo que compran dos colores a cambio es el paquete de eliminación más profundo del cubo y una base de maná que de verdad funciona. El mazo intercambia en el eje en que es mejor: mata las amenazas del rival una a una, exilia con Nemata cada criatura rival que muere, drena con Sheoldred, y acaba atacando con un Uurg que ha crecido demasiado como para bloquearlo.
